def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg,_=cnt.most_common(1)
    rs=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]
    cs=[j for j in range(W) if len(set(g[i][j] for i in range(H)))==1 and g[0][j]!=bg]
    cross=cnt[[c for c,n in cnt.most_common() if n>=2][0]]
    # pick the color that forms both a full row and a full col
    for c,_ in cnt.most_common():
        rs=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]==c]
        cs=[j for j in range(W) if len(set(g[i][j] for i in range(H)))==1 and g[0][j]==c]
        if rs and cs: cross=c; break
    kept_r=[i for i in range(H) if i!=rs[0]]; kept_c=[j for j in range(W) if j!=cs[0]]
    O=[[g[i][j] for j in kept_c] for i in kept_r]
    O_h,O_w=len(O),len(O[0])
    res=[[bg]*O_w for _ in range(O_h)]
    for ii in range(O_h):
        for jj in range(O_w):
            v=O[ii][jj]
            if v!=bg:
                for ni in (ii, O_h-1-ii):
                    for nj in (jj, O_w-1-jj):
                        if 0<=ni<O_h and 0<=nj<O_w: res[ni][nj]=cross if v!=cross else v
    return res

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg, _ = cnt.most_common(1)[0]
    rs=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]
    cs=[j for j in range(W) if len(set(g[i][j] for i in range(H)))==1 and g[0][j]!=bg]
    cross=None
    for c,_ in cnt.most_common():
        rs2=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]==c]
        cs2=[j for j in range(W) if len(set(g[i][j] for i in range(H)))==1 and g[0][j]==c]
        if rs2 and cs2: cross=c; break
    kept_r=[i for i in range(H) if i!=rs[0]]; kept_c=[j for j in range(W) if j!=cs[0]]
    O=[[g[i][j] for j in kept_c] for i in kept_r]
    O_h,O_w=len(O),len(O[0])
    res=[[bg]*O_w for _ in range(O_h)]
    for ii in range(O_h):
        for jj in range(O_w):
            v=O[ii][jj]
            if v!=bg:
                for ni in (ii, O_h-1-ii):
                    for nj in (jj, O_w-1-jj):
                        if 0<=ni<O_h and 0<=nj<O_w: res[ni][nj]=cross
    return res
